public_body: Medfield Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: Board violated the OML by approving June 11 and August 13 minutes lacking document lists and by approving insufficiently detailed August 13 minutes; no violation on the timeliness of the minutes request.

allegations.summary: Board approved June 11 and August 13 minutes that did not list the documents used at those meetings.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acknowledges, and we find, that the Board failed to include within the minutes of its meetings of June 11 or August 13 a list of documents used during those meetings.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to respond timely to a request for August 13 minutes, sent the day after the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Although Executive Director Avery’s August 14 response could have been clearer, we find that the response reasonably conveyed that the requested minutes -- for a meeting that was held the day before -- did not yet exist.

allegations.summary: Board approved August 13 minutes that were not sufficiently detailed, relying on an attached statement and omitting a nine-minute discussion.
allegations.key_passage: Because the minutes failed to sufficiently summarize discussions held during the August 13 meeting, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Within 60 days, amend the June 11 minutes to include a list of all documents used at the meeting.
Within 60 days, amend the August 13 minutes to include a list of all documents used and a sufficiently detailed summary of all discussions held.
Certify in writing to the AG's office that the minutes have been amended, as required by 940 CMR 29.07(4).
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board, within 60 days of the date of this letter, to amend the minutes of its June 11 meeting to include a list of all documents used at the meeting and to amend the minutes of its August 13 meeting to include a list of all documents used at the meeting and a sufficiently detailed summary of all discussions held, in conformance with this letter.
